cards.word: Be slow to promise and quick to perform

हिंदी: वादा सोच-समझकर करो और जल्दी निभाओ

cards.word: Better safe than sorry

cards.word: Better to light a candle than curse the darkness

cards.word: Cut your coat according to your cloth

cards.word: Do unto others as you would have them do unto you

cards.word: Easy come, easy go

cards.word: Empty pockets never held anyone back

cards.word: Failure is the stepping stone to success

cards.word: First come, first served

cards.word: Forgive and forget

cards.word: Good things come to those who wait
